Cors.//: No origins allowed by default. Development supplies http://localhost:4200 in appsettings.Development.json; a deployed frontend's origin belongs here or in an environment-specific override, never wildcarded.

RateLimiting.//: Production tuning values (CLAUDE.md §4.4-adjacent hardening pass). Partitioned by remote IP in Program.cs — never a client-supplied header. These are conservative starting points, not load-tested numbers; revisit once real traffic patterns are known. AuthenticationTestHost overrides both to an effectively unlimited value for the integration suite, which has no shared token cache.

Jwt.//: SigningKey is deliberately absent (CLAUDE.md 4.4). Supply it via 'dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:SigningKey <32+ chars>' in development, or the Jwt__SigningKey environment variable elsewhere. Startup fails if it is missing or shorter than 32 characters.

Activation.//: How long an emailed invitation stays redeemable (POST /auth/activate). Nothing secret here, so unlike Jwt and Email this section is committed whole. Absolute — nothing extends it, and there is no way to re-issue an invitation today, which is the argument for a week rather than a day.

Email.//: Smtp:Username and Smtp:Password are deliberately absent (CLAUDE.md 4.4), like Jwt:SigningKey above. Supply them via 'dotnet user-secrets set Email:Smtp:Password <value>' in development, or the Email__Smtp__Username / Email__Smtp__Password environment variables elsewhere. DeliveryMode is Smtp here on purpose: a deployment that forgets to configure a host fails at startup rather than silently dropping invitations. appsettings.Development.json selects DevelopmentSink, which writes each message to disk instead of sending it. Security is StartTls (port 587, every transactional provider's relay); SslOnConnect is port 465, and None refuses to carry a credential at all.
